title: A Plane on a Sextic Calabi-Yau Fourfold: Residual Quintic Surfaces, Host Ideals, and Determinantal Self-Correction in Lean 4

description: Three-paper algebraic geometry suite and 7-module Lean 4 formalization (BenFrohman/DerivedCategories) studying a smooth sextic Calabi-Yau fourfold Y = V(F) ⊂ P^5 containing a plane Π = V(x3,x4,x5): (1) A Plane on a Sextic Calabi-Yau Fourfold and a Three-Parameter Family of Residual Quintic Surfaces ([Π] + [S_{a,b,c}] = h^2, self-intersection Π.Π = 21, Π.S = -20, S.S = 25, Gram determinant 125); (2) Containing a Plane Is a Linear Condition on Homogeneous Polynomials; and (3) A Self-Correction on Determinantal Sextics, the Trichotomy Wall, and why the Berglund-Hübsch Transpose F^T Is Not a Smooth Projective Fourfold.
